blurb: Beaver Meadow offers around 5km of variable terrain cross-country ski trails maintained by the City of Concord Parks and Recreation Department. Trails are groomed daily as conditions allow, using a snowmobile groomer or the Snow Rabbit Groomer. Skiing is free to use when trails are open, with parking and clubhouse access including restrooms and snacks during opening hours.
